Art. Right here on your doorstep.
 

OPPORTUNITIES

Contemporary Calgary's mission is to provide Calgary and its visitors with a significant visual arts destination dedicated to modern and contemporary art. Contemporary Calgary shares a passion for art that is relevant, meaningful and challenging. We believe in the power of art to transform the places and the lives we live. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse, respectful and inclusive environment, and encourage applications from all qualified candidates.

JOB OPPORTUNITIES

  • Contemporary Cagary is seeking a full-time Capital Project Accountant.

    With the Centennial Planetarium Transformation Project underway and expected to be completed in 2030, we are seeking a Capital Project Accountant to provide disciplined financial oversight for this major, multi-year investment. The successful candidate will partner closely with project leadership, contractors, consultants and funders, maintaining strong controls, reliable forecasts and transparent reporting from the construction phase through to close-out.

    Contemporary Calgary is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse, respectful and inclusive environment that is reflective of the community we serve. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates for this position.

    Please apply with a PDF cover letter and resume by end of business day Friday November 13, 2026 to: careers@contemporarycalgary.com

VOLUNTEER OPPORTUNITIES

  • Call for Exhibition Volunteers

    We are thrilled to invite volunteers to join us for our upcoming international group exhibition, Tectonic Shifts, showcasing work from artists worldwide.

    What will your role involve?

    As an Exhibition Volunteer, you will play a key role in enhancing the visitor experience. You will assist visitors by engaging them in conversations about the artworks, helping them connect with the exhibition, and answering general questions. Your responsibilities will also include offering friendly guidance—such as clarifying which works are interactive and which are for viewing only—ensuring a welcoming atmosphere, and providing support as needed throughout the space.

    What are the requirements?

    We ask for volunteers to commit to at least one shift per week from December through April. Shifts are available on Wednesdays, Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays from 12-7 PM, and Sundays from 12-5 PM.

    If you’re interested in volunteering, please submit your interest by November 17th, 2026.

    If you have any questions about this volunteer position, please reach out to Sabine Levesque at sabine@contemporarycalgary.com 

    Contemporary Calgary is committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and respectful volunteer community and encourages applications from all individuals. Please note that we only accept applications from those aged 18 and older.

    APPLY TODAY
